mapper.select: SELECT id,command_id,serial_id,sku_id,pick_fact_id,balance_id,shipment_ref,owner_epoch,state,claim_epoch,attempts FROM serial_shipment_intent WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE serial_shipment_intent SET state='RUNNING',claim_epoch=claim_epoch+1,attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt_at=#{until},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND id=#{id} AND claim_epoch=#{epoch} AND attempts<12

UPDATE serial_shipment_intent SET state=#{state},result_json=CAST(#{result,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSON),last_error=#{error},next_attempt_at=#{next},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND id=#{id} AND claim_epoch=#{epoch} AND state IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')

UPDATE serial_shipment_intent SET state='PENDING',attempts=0,claim_epoch=claim_epoch+1,next_attempt_at=#{now},last_error=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND id=#{id} AND claim_epoch=#{epoch} AND state='ISOLATED'
